probeB_mechanismTrace.mechanism: On OAuth callback, if (onlyForAccount && accounts.length===0 && session && !inviteAttempted) -> createUserForAccount(onlyForAccount, session) runs. It looks up the db entity's add_user.reference as the PARENT for a new person, then POSTs {_type:person, _parent:<that reference>, _inheritrights:true, entu_user:{...}, email, name} and sets _editor:self. onlyForAccount is the db= query param scoping the OAuth request to a single account; inviteAttempted is true only when an invite= query param was present.
probeB_mechanismTrace.crossCheck: Confirmed both existing OAuth-linked persons have _parent = 69bcfd8e9c031ab8e6ce807a (the db entity itself) -- 6a2fc05e4cd971291c5d5ddc (mihkel.putrinsh@gmail.com) and 69bcfd8e9c031ab8e6ce8079 (mitselek@gmail.com). This exactly matches createUserForAccount's _parent assignment, strongly indicating BOTH were created by this exact code path in the past.
probeB_mechanismTrace.conclusion: add_user is present and correctly configured (a valid self-referencing parent) -- the mechanism is NOT broken or misconfigured at the db level, and has demonstrably worked twice before. add_user absence/misconfiguration is RULED OUT as the explanation for B's missing person. The gap must be in the specific request B's sign-in made: either onlyForAccount (db= param) was not 'polyphony', or an invite= param was present routing through the (no-op, since no stored invite exists for B) invite-acceptance branch instead, or the session did not complete server-side. Recommend checking the mvox app's actual login-initiation URL/params for whatever flow B used, and/or server-side auth logs for B's request, as the next diagnostic step -- outside my remit/access to pursue further.
